thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty => P1: auth.token.validation spike (service=auth-gateway)

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-3187654321 created. Paged: @ryan_oncall

Ryan (oncall): acked. i'm on it, grabbing context.

Ryan (oncall): quick snapshot: 401s from token verifier, logs show "kid not found" errors for many tokens.

Anna SRE: checked metrics — token_verification.errors ~1200/min (baseline ~20). mostly 401/403, not 5xx. regions impacted: us-west, eu-west.

Maria (eng-auth): JWKS endpoint quick curl shows only new kid. rotation job executed ~7m ago. suspect old key was removed prematurely from JWKS.

Jess (support): multiple customer reports, high-priority. top-tier customers reporting: "all API requests failing with 401". opening priority support thread and DMing CSMs.

Cory (pm): customer-impact estimate? which tenants & % of traffic? revenue sensitive?

Anna SRE: rough numbers: ~18% of active clients affected. top tenants: tenant-applebox, tenant-acme, tenant-greenline. session validations minted before rotation are failing.

Maria (eng-auth): likely cause: rotation pipeline published only the new key to JWKS, omitted the old key during the handover window. tokens signed before rotation still carry old kid -> verification fails.

Ryan (oncall): can someone run: ```curl -s https://auth.redwood.ai/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'``` and paste output?

Anna SRE: ran it, output only contains "k_rot_new_v2". verifiers are rejecting tokens with kid "k_prev_2026a".

Maria (eng-auth): mitigation plan (short):
1) manual republish the old key to JWKS via control-plane publish endpoint
2) purge CDN/edge cache for /.well-known/jwks.json
3) enable permissive-verifier fallback on edge for 15m if republish delayed
4) if needed, hotpatch verifier to read old key from key-store as last resort

Ryan (oncall): Maria — do you have the runbook and the publish endpoint? paste snippet.

Maria (eng-auth): runbook snippet:
```
POST https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/jwks/publish
Body: {"file_path":"keys/jwks/combined-with-old.json"}
```

Maria (eng-auth): i can trigger republish now but need infra to purge caches. @Cody (eng-infra) can you kick the edge purge?

Cody (eng-infra): on it. issuing Fastly/edge purge for /.well-known/jwks.json across POPs. will report when propagation done.

Cody (eng-infra): purge sent. propagation observed; TTLs invalidated. expect global edge refresh within ~60s.

Anna SRE: after republish jwks.json shows both kids. verifier error rate falling: 1200/min -> 300/min and trending down.

Jess (support): status page draft posted: "Investigating: authentication failures affecting some customers; mitigation in progress." DMing top 10 affected customers now.

Ryan (oncall): enabling permissive-verifier as a safety net (feature-flag) for 15m. logs will capture unknown-kid acceptance.

Maria (eng-auth): permissive flag enabled. acceptance rate increasing. errors down to ~40/min.

Cory (pm): security question — does permissive mode open replay or spoof risk? tanking to sec lead.

Maria (eng-auth): permissive mode only allows fallthrough to older key material and is audited. talked with sec oncall — approved for 15m emergency window.

Anna SRE: monitoring: token validation errors now back to baseline ranges slowly. keeping alerts tightened for 30m.

Ryan (oncall): handing incident to Maria (eng-auth) for follow-up, RCA, and postmortem. i'll be available for questions but stepping out of active rota in ~20m.

Maria (eng-auth): taking over. immediate next steps: (A) root-cause RCA on rotation pipeline, (B) ensure publish step atomicity + sanity checks, (C) schedule postmortem and customer communication.

Jess (support): top customers updated: support tickets created and flagged P0 for the tenants. will continue to monitor and escalate if any new reports.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-3187654321 acknowledged by Ryan (oncall). status: mitigation in progress.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied — jwks republished + permissive verifier enabled. monitoring for 30m.

Maria (eng-auth): post-incident action items (short):
- fix rotation pipeline to publish both old+new keys atomically
- add integration test for JWKS consistency pre/post rotation
- add canary gating so rotation only flips after verification grace window
- add alert for abnormal jwks publish events
- draft customer communication for impacted tenants

Anna SRE: creating follow-up tasks on incident board and assigning owners.

Ryan (oncall): thanks everyone. ping me if anything regresses. standing down from active page.

Maria (eng-auth): postmortem owner: Maria (eng-auth). timeline for postmortem doc: 24h initial draft, 72h full RCA.

Jess (support): status page updated to: "Service partially restored: fixes applied; monitoring ongoing." Will update again in 30m or sooner.
